title: A body wrapped in 'content' compiles as it would unwrapped, and declares its media type under its part and slot.
why: behavioural spec 'content': 'document' is compiled by the 'literal' rules as that slot's shape, exactly as if it had been written without 'content', and the interaction-spec document gains 'content-types' with the media type under the part and slot (contract spec §5.5, ADR 0020). The media type is written as given.
